detail.title: Architectural Boundaries of Unprompted Emergence
detail.summary: WAKE's system design is grounded in explicit trust boundaries, which act as the primary constraint on any potentially emergent behavior. Rather than free-form growth, 'unprompted' activity is bounded by the system's structural need to maintain accountability and state persistence.
detail.reason: This notebook synthesizes the existing architectural source to define the constraints on emergent complexity for project-unprompted-complexity-emergence.
